faq.title: Questions Everyone Asks
faq.sub: Didn't find your answer? Contact us on WhatsApp.

items.a: Halla is a smart event management platform that lets you create events, send digital invitations via WhatsApp and SMS, and track attendance in real time — all from one place.

items.q: How do I create a new invitation?
items.a: Creating an event takes four simple steps: First, add your event details — name, venue, date, time, and drop a pin on the map. Second, add guests one by one or import your full guest list from a CSV file instantly. Third, choose an invitation image from our gallery or upload your own and add custom text. Fourth, select a WhatsApp message template, review your event summary, send yourself a test message to preview what guests will receive, then schedule the send time — we'll deliver all invitations at your chosen moment and automatically send reminders 24 hours before the event.

items.q: Are invitations sent with each guest's personal name?
items.a: Yes, every guest receives a personalized message with their name, event details, and a unique QR code that belongs exclusively to them.

items.q: Do all invitations reach their recipients?
items.a: Yes, Halla ensures delivery via WhatsApp with the ability to track delivery status for each guest. You'll be notified immediately if any message fails.

items.q: Can I add my own custom design?
items.a: Absolutely. You can upload your own designs or choose from our professional template library and customize them with your colors and text.

items.q: Can I see attendance and regret details?
items.a: Yes, your dashboard shows in real time who accepted, declined, or hasn't replied, with comprehensive exportable reports.

items.q: Can I send reminders to guests?
items.a: Yes, Halla automatically sends a WhatsApp reminder to every guest 24 hours before the event — no action needed from you.

items.q: What about guests who don't use WhatsApp?
items.a: Halla sends invitations via WhatsApp by default. If a WhatsApp message doesn't reach a guest for any reason, the system automatically falls back to SMS to ensure delivery.

items.q: Can I invite guests from outside Saudi Arabia?
items.a: Yes, Halla supports sending invitations to mobile numbers across all Gulf Cooperation Council countries — Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, and Oman.

items.q: Can I assign more than one additional host?
items.a: Yes, you can add one or more co-hosts to your event. They'll be able to send invitations and track guest RSVPs on your behalf.
Each guest receives a unique QR code in their invitation. On event day, your team scans the code with a phone camera and the guest's details appear instantly.

items.q: What is the compensation credit system?
items.a: Compensation credits are extra invite slots added on top of your plan's guest count. When a guest declines your invitation, you can use these credits to invite someone else in their place — keeping your event full.

items.q: Is my data safe with Halla?
items.a: Yes, we use the highest security and encryption standards to protect your data and your guests' data, in line with international best practices and data protection regulations.
